{"CommandLine":"/mnt/home/japake298/project/GraphConjecturing/.venv/bin/python -u -c '
import networkx as nx
import itertools

# We can generate all connected graphs on 8 vertices or search trees and low degree graphs
# Actually, networkx has geng or graph generators, or we can use random generation
# But wait! What graphs have radius >= 3 on n=8?
# Diam >= 3, up to 7.
# Let us search among all trees on n=8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16!
print("Testing trees up to n=18...")
for n in range(8, 19):
    trees = list(nx.nonisomorphic_trees(n))
    for T in trees:
        r = nx.radius(T)
        if r <= 1: continue
        # compute roman domination of T using tree DP or pulp
        # Fast Roman domination for T
        import pulp
        prob = pulp.LpProblem("R", pulp.LpMinimize)
        nodes = list(T.nodes())
        x = {v: pulp.LpVariable(f"x_{v}", cat="Binary") for v in nodes}
        y = {v: pulp.LpVariable(f"y_{v}", cat="Binary") for v in nodes}
        prob += pulp.lpSum(x[v] + 2*y[v] for v in nodes)
        for v in nodes:
            prob += x[v] + y[v] + pulp.lpSum(y[u] for u in T.neighbors(v)) >= 1
            prob += x[v] + y[v] <= 1
        prob.solve(pulp.PULP_CBC_CMD(msg=0))
        rom = int(pulp.value(prob.objective))
        if r + 1 > rom:
            print(f"COUNTEREXAMPLE TREE! n={n}, r={r}, rom={rom}")
            exit(0)
    print(f"All {len(trees)} trees on n={n} passed.")

print("All trees up to n=18 passed!")
